title: Understanding the Role of the Vector $$1$$
text: Consider the role of the vector $$1$$ in the context of the design matrix X. What does it mean for a vector to be in the span of a matrix?

title: Span of a Matrix
text: The span of a matrix consists of all possible linear combinations of its columns. If a vector is in the span of a matrix, it can be expressed as a linear combination of the matrix's columns.

title: The Role of the Intercept

title: Expressing $$1$$ as a Linear Combination

title: Conclusion
text: Since the vector $$1$$ can be expressed as a linear combination of the columns of X, it is in the span of X.
